target: Src kinetic fluorescence in source instrument units
timing: Predict all t>7.5 min from source dose and same-curve measurements at 3,4.5,6 min. Calibration fixed at6 min; no later response access.
grouping: Complete dose curves; seven development and two hash-selected confirmation doses; leave-one-dose-out validation. No biological replicate identifiers.
primary_metric: MAE averaged within group, then equally across groups
calibration: Predict all t>7.5 min from source dose and same-curve measurements at 3,4.5,6 min. Calibration fixed at6 min; no later response access.
selection: Smallest development group-balanced OOF MAE among baseline/candidate families; within1% choose lower parameter count. Confirmation never selects reference.
continuation: At least5 material hypotheses, continue justified distinct hypotheses until2 consecutive after minimum5 show no improvement of >1% in prediction or explicit robustness/interpretation. No retuning after confirmation.
uncertainty: No row bootstrap; enumerate group errors and leave-group development variability. Single heldout condition is bounded evidence.
exposure_audit: First9 lines and schemas inspected; early values through6.75 min were visible across doses, outside target window. Later outcomes not printed before freeze.
